edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin from msg.sender, making the first caller the administrator.
msg.sender is compared against admin to authorize _setPendingImplementation.
msg.sender must equal pendingWanFarmImplementation to accept implementation.
msg.sender is compared against admin to authorize _setPendingAdmin.
msg.sender must equal pendingAdmin to accept admin rights.
admin state variable is written from msg.sender in the constructor.
_setPendingImplementation writes newPendingImplementation into pendingWanFarmImplementation.
_acceptImplementation assigns wanFarmImplementation from pendingWanFarmImplementation.
_acceptImplementation clears pendingWanFarmImplementation to address(0).
_setPendingAdmin writes newPendingAdmin into pendingAdmin.
_acceptAdmin transfers admin rights by assigning pendingAdmin to admin.
_acceptAdmin clears pendingAdmin to address(0).
_setPendingImplementation returns via fail() when the caller is not admin.
_acceptImplementation returns via fail() when the caller is not the pending implementation.
_setPendingAdmin returns via fail() when the caller is not admin.
_acceptAdmin returns via fail() when the caller is not the pending admin.
Fallback delegatecalls the implementation with msg.data, executing external code in this contract's storage context.
The delegatecall target address is read from wanFarmImplementation state variable.
newPendingImplementation is the input parameter of _setPendingImplementation.
newPendingAdmin is the input parameter of _setPendingAdmin.
err is the error code reported by fail().
info is the failure info reported by fail().
err is the error code reported by failOpaque().
info is the failure info reported by failOpaque().
opaqueError is emitted by failOpaque() as the detail code.
newPendingImplementation becomes the stored pendingWanFarmImplementation.
newPendingAdmin becomes the stored pendingAdmin.
oldPendingImplementation caches the previous pendingWanFarmImplementation value.
oldImplementation caches the previous wanFarmImplementation value.
oldPendingImplementation caches the previous pendingWanFarmImplementation value in _acceptImplementation.
oldPendingAdmin caches the previous pendingAdmin value in _setPendingAdmin.
oldAdmin caches the previous admin value before transfer.
oldPendingAdmin caches the previous pendingAdmin value in _acceptAdmin.
success is assigned from the boolean result of the delegatecall.
